newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Philippines bans meat imports from Taiwan.
newsitem.headline: Philippines bans meat imports from Taiwan.

text.p: The Philippines has banned the importation of livestock and meat products from Taiwan following reports of an outbreak of foot and mouth desease in the country, the Bureau of Animal Industry (BAI) said on Tuesday.

The BAI said in a statement it was ordered by Agriculture Secretary Salvador Escudero to impose the ban to ensure that no infected livestock or contaminated meat and meat products entered the country.
The Philippines mostly imports pig skin from Taiwan for the native Filipino delicacy "chicharon", which are crisps made from pig skin.
On March 26, Escudero had also ordered a ban on the importation of live pigs and pork products from Germany and the Netherlands due to a reported outbreak of swine fever in both countries.
